# Health Estate Journal

> > Health Estate Journal is a comprehensive directory and information resource for healthcare estates, facilities management, and NHS suppliers across the United Kingdom.

The journal serves healthcare estates professionals by providing supplier directories, company listings, and contact information for equipment, furniture, and facilities management services. It focuses on connecting NHS and healthcare organizations with verified suppliers across various regions including Birmingham, Bolton, Lancashire, and other UK locations.

## Key Topics

- NHS healthcare suppliers
- Healthcare estates management
- Facilities management
- Medical equipment suppliers
- Healthcare furniture
- UK healthcare infrastructure
- Supplier directories
- Birmingham healthcare sector
- Bolton healthcare suppliers
- Equipment hire services
- Healthcare technology providers
- Peter Moon (editor/contributor)
- Intercall healthcare systems
- Haigh Engineering
